newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures edge down, trade slack pre-FOMC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures edge down, trade slack pre-FOMC.

text.p: U.S. debt futures edged lower in nervous early trading, but action overall was slack as players await results of the Fed's policy meeting today.
The Federal Open Market Committee meeting began at 0800 CDT/1300 GMT and results are expected around 1315 CDT/1815 GMT.
Most traders said the market was evenly split over whether the Fed would raise rates a quarter-point or would leave them unchanged.
The Fed raised the fed funds target a quarter-point at its March 25 meeting to 5.50 percent.

"It's a little quiet and the dealers are selling," a T-bond futures trader said. "The market is trading below the high volume area of 110-1/32 to 7/32 and is obviously nervous, but (it's) not moving real actively and there's no volume."
June T-bond futures dipped below Friday's and Monday's session lows to hit 109-20/32, but the range was very tight.
The trader said he thought the Fed was unlikely to raise rates today, but said his firm's official stance called for a 25-basis-point rate rise.
"I'd say there is a 30 percent chance of tightening," he said. "I think they move in July."

Traders said the market would remain choppy but in tight ranges early today because all FOMC bets have been placed. But traders were uncertain how the market would react once the FOMC's results are released this afternoon.
"That's going to be the interesting thing -- how people play it once the decision is made," the T-bond trader said.
"Some people think it's going up regardless and some people think it's going down regardless," he said.
A Eurodollar trader said December Euros could rally to last week's high if the Fed stands pat, but added that he thought any rally would be a selling opportunity.
Another Euro trader put Dec support at 93.64 and resistance at 93.70.
"I think they're going to keep a tight lid on it up until the FOMC," he said.

At 0821 CDT/1321 GMT, June T-bonds were down 7/32 at 109-22/32, T-notes fell 5/32 to 107-3/32, muni-bonds fell 3/32 to 116-14/32, Sept T-bills fell 0.015 to 94.470, and December Eurodollars were down 0.020 at 93.655. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
